create_ResolutionSampler: create a ResolutionSampler instance with batch_size and dim_keys to bucket data by tensor dimensions
consume_data_items: consume a batch of data dictionaries into the ResolutionSampler for dimension-based bucketing
get_batch_from_sampler: get a completed batch from the ResolutionSampler when enough items fill a dimension bucket
check_sampler_ready: check if the ResolutionSampler has a ready batch available via the is_ready property
build_batch_sampler_pipeline: build a data sampling pipeline that groups dictionaries into batches by matching tensor dimensions
